title: The Saint's Bones
text: A reliquary of bones lies in a ruined chapel, its glass broken, its gold long stripped, the bones themselves unguarded and yellow as old wax. Pilgrims kneel around it in the rubble. They say the bones cure the sick. Some of the pilgrims are missing fingers.

options.label: The most hurt touches the bones, and begs the saint for mercy.

outcomes.text: It works, and the pilgrims murmur. One of them hides her hand.
Nothing happens, and the pilgrims look away.

options.label: Pray before the bones, among the faithful and the maimed.

outcomes.text: A quiet hour among the missing fingers, and no one asks for yours.

options.label: The Leader takes a finger bone. The saint has plenty.

outcomes.text: A relic is a relic. The saint may not agree.
